title: Timeless Homeowner's Collection Vacation Rental
meta_description: With timeless appeal, the spacious ‘Timeless’ cottage enjoys a spectacular location and gracious features.
description_expanded: 814 Forest StreetA Gracious Seaside Cottage with Timeless Southern CharmWith enduring appeal and an exceptional location, Timeless is a spacious Seaside cottage that blends classic Southern hospitality with relaxed coastal living. Designed for gathering and gracious outdoor living, the home features expansive first- and second-floor porches spanning the entire front of the cottage, offering ample space for outdoor dining, porch swings, rocking chairs, and leisurely afternoons enjoying the views.Elegant First-Floor Living & Sleeping QuartersInside, the first floor welcomes guests with a refined sitting area accented by custom built-ins, setting a warm and inviting tone. The ground-level king primary bedroom offers a peaceful retreat, complete with a private shower bath, dual vanities, and a cozy fireplace. Two additional first-floor bedrooms each accommodate twin beds and share a convenient Jack-and-Jill bathroom, making this level ideal for families or groups traveling together.Light-Filled Second Floor with Living, Dining & KitchenThe second floor opens to a comfortable living room centered around a fireplace and flat-screen television. Oversized windows fill the space with natural light, enhancing the airy coastal feel. Just beyond, a well-appointed kitchen leads to a side balcony, creating another inviting space for outdoor dining or quiet moments in the Seaside breeze. Back inside, a large formal dining table seats up to ten guests, while a second-floor queen bedroom with a full bath provides additional privacy and comfort.Loft & Tower Deck with Scenic Seaside ViewsA spiral staircase leads to a cozy loft-style sleeping area, furnished with a convenient daybed. Just a few steps above, the open third-level tower deck offers an elevated escape—perfect for greeting the sunrise or watching the sunset over the charming rooftops of Seaside.Prime Location Near Pools, Beach & Guesthouse OptionIdeally located directly across from the West Side swimming pool, Timeless provides easy access to Seaside’s renowned amenities, including multiple swimming pools, tennis courts, and a fitness center. The property also serves as the main house to the guest cottage Time Out of Time, offering the flexibility to rent the homes separately or together—an ideal solution for larger families or guests seeking additional privacy while vacationing together.* Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign registration. 5-night minimum Spring, Spring Break and Summer; 3-night minimum Fall; 2-night minimum Winter.FEATURES2,360 square feet of spacious living, located directly across from the West Side swimming poolAccess to the Seaside Private Residential Beach at Odessa Pavilion, the largest private residential beach along Scenic Highway 30A4-minute walk (352 yards) to Seaside’s sugar-white sand beach accessThird-level tower deck, ideal for sunrise and sunset views over SeasideExpansive front and upper porches designed for outdoor lounging and diningPeacock Alley linens, featuring fresh, luxurious sheets and plush towels throughout the homeAccess to 3 community swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts, and 3 pickleball courts (court fees apply), along with a fitness centerWelcome tote including two beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and two complimentary rental bikes for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityStarter amenities provided, along with personalized guest service throughout your stayParking policy: Two parking passes are issued for two-bedroom and larger homes. Golf carts are considered vehiclesGolf cart policy: Golf carts are not permitted for non-homeowners visiting Seaside. Special circumstances or medical needs require an approved golf cart permitNo pets allowedSTR23-002362
